cobbleston_tavern.description: An old drinker swears he knows what lurks on the road ahead.

Buy him a drink and inquire (-15 gold).result_text: He sketches a crude map and presses a pair of grapes into your hand.

Leave him to his cups.result_text: You finish your water and move on.

rippletide_stall.description: A fishmonger has, inexplicably, a crate of soulstones.

Buy a Fire Soulstone (40 gold).result_text: The stone is warm to the touch.

Walk away.result_text: You leave the fish to the gulls.

suspicious_noble.description: A noble with a heavy purse glares at everyone who passes.

Pick his pocket (Steal).result_text: Your fingers find the purse. He never notices.

Charm him (Allure).result_text: Flattered, he hands over a 'trinket' to be rid of you.

Challenge him (Provoke).result_text: He declines with a sneer. Someone else will have to teach him manners.

atlasdam_library.description: Shelves of forbidden tomes stretch into the dark.

Study the Arcane Primer.result_text: You emerge hours later, head throbbing but sharper.

Read a Field Manual.result_text: You learn a few tricks for staying alive.

sacred_flame_shrine.display_name: A Shrine of the Sacred Flame
sacred_flame_shrine.description: A small flame burns here that has never gone out.

Kneel and pray.description: Warmth floods through you. The flame flickers expectantly.

abandoned_cart.description: A merchant's cart lies overturned beside the road, its owner long gone.

Search the cart.result_text: Among the debris you find coin and supplies.

Leave it be.result_text: Some things are best left alone.

sunshade_stage.description: The tavern's dancer has fallen ill and the crowd is restless.

Take the stage.result_text: The crowd roars. Coins rain down, and you leave with a new swagger.

Watch from the back.result_text: You enjoy the show and a free meal.

bandit_ambush.description: Masked figures step out from the trees. 'Your purse or your life.'

lizardman_warband.description: A chieftain in a bone crown hisses orders to his kin.

flamesgrace_guardian.display_name: The Guardian of the First Flame
flamesgrace_guardian.description: The sacred flame rises from its brazier and takes shape. It will not let you pass.

clearbrook_viper.description: A serpent mottled with sickly purple uncoils from the cave mouth.
